name: Guizhou Zhenhua E-chem Inc.
summary: Guizhou Zhenhua E-chem Inc. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of cathode materials for lithium/sodium-ion batteries in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers lithium cobalt oxide, LCO/NCM hybrid cathod, and lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, as well as lithium nickel manganese oxide products. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Zhenhua New Material Co.,LTD and changed its name to Guizhou Zhenhua E-chem Inc. in May 2018. Guizhou Zhenhua E-chem Inc. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Guiyang, the People's Republic of China.
